source: ECharts 6.1 dist: component/legend/LegendView.ts getLegendStyle / getDefaultLegendIcon, chart/line/LineSeries.ts getLegendIcon

cases.note: a line's lineStyle.color: the rule in it, the marker in the data's colour
itemStyle.color only: the line visual's stroke is the data's fill
lineStyle.width 6 and 0: 'auto' is 2 where the series' width is above 0, else 0
legend lineStyle.width 'inherit': the series' own width
legend lineStyle.width 5; an item's own 1
an item's lineStyle color / width 'inherit' over the legend's: the series' again
an item's lineStyle.color 'none': no rule (its path still in the group's rect)
a series' lineStyle.color '' (falsy): the line visual's stroke is the data's fill
two legends, the second unselecting A: the series is filtered, so legend 0's selected A has an empty line visual -- no rule colour, no rule
lineStyle.type dashed, dotted, [6, 3] with dashOffset 2: inherited, dashed in the rule's width
dashed under legend width 'inherit' (a 6 px line): the dash in 6s
lineStyle cap round / square, join bevel, miterLimit 4: inherited
lineStyle.opacity 0.4: the rule's; itemStyle.opacity 0.7: the marker's
a series' lineStyle shadow: not inherited (the legend's lineStyle names no shadow key)
legend lineStyle shadow: the rule's
legend lineStyle shadow keys 'inherit': the series'
legend lineStyle.color; an item's own over it
legend lineStyle.color 'auto': the style visual's fill, not the line's colour
legend lineStyle type / cap / opacity written: over the series'
unselected from the start: the rule in lineStyle.inactiveColor at inactiveWidth 2; a filtered series has no legendLineStyle visual, so every 'inherit' key reads nothing (no dash, no opacity)
unselected by legendToggleSelect after a first render: the series' data keeps the visual it had
unselected from the start, then selected again: the visual as selected
lineStyle inactiveColor / inactiveWidth, inactiveColor / inactiveBorderColor written
a gradient lineStyle.color: the rule stroked with it
a gradient itemStyle.color: the rule (the data's fill) and an empty marker's ring stroked with it
legend icon 'rect': the default icon, no rule; data icon 'inherit': the line's own
icon 'line' on a line series: the default icon's line symbol, styled by itemStyle
a filled marker with the series' border: 'auto' width 2, borderColor inherited; an empty one ringed in its fill
legend itemStyle color / borderColor / borderWidth / opacity written
itemStyle cap / join / dashOffset / miterLimit inherited; borderType not (no 'inherit' default)
itemStyle shadow not inherited; legend itemStyle shadow applied
legend itemStyle borderType / shadowBlur 'inherit': the series'
legend lineStyle on bars: no effect -- the default icon reads itemStyle
icon 'line' on bars: stroked by itemStyle's stroke (the series' border) at 'auto' width
an unselected bar with a border: inactiveColor fill, inactiveBorderColor at 2
scatter emptyCircle / emptyRect icons: stroked in the fill at 2, filled white
scatter emptyCircle / emptyRect as the legendIcon visual: stroked in the fill at 2, filled white; the default opacity 0.8 inherited
a line's series colour: the rule and the marker in it
a pie with a border: the slices' icons

a lines series (drawn with its stroke): its style visual is its lineStyle -- cap, join, miterLimit inherited, opacity not (the line visual's, which a lines series has none of), its type not (borderType has no 'inherit' default)
a boxplot (drawn with its stroke): borderCap / borderJoin inherited, opacity not
a funnel's default border (1 in the ground colour) and its borderJoin
legend itemStyle borderWidth 'inherit': the series' border width
legend itemStyle color / borderColor 'auto': the style visual's fill
inactiveBorderWidth 1 (not 'auto'): an unselected icon keeps the width its style resolved
unselected under inactiveBorderWidth 'auto': 2 where the series has a width and the resolved style a stroke -- the legend's borderColor counts
legend itemStyle opacity '-Infinity' (a string): not a number the canvas takes -- drawn opaque
a graph's categories: the category's style visual under the legend style
legend lineStyle.width 5 does not thicken an empty marker's ring

guards: rule.color: the rule red, the marker in the palette
rule.icon.word: one path for A, two for B
